description:
A pull request that changes only markdown can run the `lint` and `test (ubuntu-latest, 3.12)` jobs: the full fast suite, which has a 45-minute timeout. The two path classifiers in `ci.yml` disagree about markdown.

**Path filters** (`.github/path-filters.yml`, read by `scripts/path_filter_decision.py`) list `docs/agent/**` (line 64), `docs/*/dependency-audit-raw.md` and `docs/*/agent-instruction*.md` as code. Root `*.md`, `_blog/**` and the `_project` notes folders are safe content.

**Unit map** (`.github/ci-units.yml`, read by `scripts/ci_units.py`) puts the same `docs/agent/**` and named markdown files in `core` (lines 35-39). It also puts root `*.md` (line 100), `_blog/**` and `_project/**` in `tooling`. `ci_units.py` sets `code_tests_needed = core or tooling`, and that output gates both `code-lint` and `code-test`.

What `classify_units` returns for single-file changes:

| Changed file | Units | code_tests_needed |
|---|---|---|
| `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` | tooling | true |
| `_blog/x.md`, `_project/notes/x.md` | tooling | true |
| `docs/agent/attribution-surfaces.md` | core, docs | true |
| `docs/internal/comment-policy.md` | docs | false |

So a typo fix in `README.md`, or in any `docs/agent/` page, runs the whole Python suite. Path filters already call root markdown safe content.

Why the rules exist: some tests read files in `docs/agent/` as inputs. `test_agent_instruction_audit.py` and `test_blind_spot_tools.py` read `review-protocol.md`, `test_pr_refresh_certification.py` reads `identity-instruction-boundary.md`, and `test_todo_review_own_edit_freshness.py` reads `todo-review.md`. `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` feed the agent-instruction audit. The folder-wide globs were copied into `core` when the six-unit map replaced the old path filters (`c7bcdb9bc`, "report six unit results from one workflow"). Most `docs/agent/` pages, such as `attribution-surfaces.md` and `audit-evidence-provenance.md`, are not test inputs.
